body_zh: 周一上午，一家社区医院的内科门诊共接诊126名患者，其中复诊患者约占一半。挂号处7点半开门，到9点时已发出80多个号。当天有4名医生出诊，平均每人接诊30余人，门诊在中午12点前结束。
body_en: On Monday morning, the internal medicine clinic of a community hospital saw 126 patients, about half of them on return visits. The registration office opened at half past seven, and by nine more than 80 numbers had been issued. Four doctors were on duty that day, each seeing more than 30 patients on average, and the clinic finished before noon.

body_zh: 门诊药房当天调配处方412张，比前一天多出37张。上午的取药高峰出现在10点左右，最长等候时间约为20分钟。下午6个窗口同时开放，排队的人明显减少。下班前，药师补齐了货架上缺少的药品。
body_en: The outpatient pharmacy filled 412 prescriptions that day, 37 more than the day before. The morning rush for collecting medicine came at around ten, with the longest wait at about 20 minutes. In the afternoon six windows were open at once, and the queues grew noticeably shorter. Before the end of the shift, the pharmacists restocked the medicines missing from the shelves.

body_zh: 门诊大厅的地面铺着浅灰色的瓷砖，正中摆着两排蓝色座椅。挂号窗口沿北墙一字排开，上方的电子屏滚动显示各科室的候诊人数。大厅西北角有一台饮水机，旁边立着一块楼层指示牌，墙上还挂着一面圆形的时钟。
body_en: The floor of the outpatient hall is laid with light gray tiles, and two rows of blue seats stand in the middle. The registration windows line up along the north wall, and an electronic screen above them scrolls the number of patients waiting for each department. In the northwest corner of the hall there is a water dispenser with a floor directory sign beside it, and a round clock hangs on the wall.

body_zh: 体检中心的身高体重测量仪放在走廊尽头，底座是一块方形的金属踏板，立柱上装着可以升降的横杆。机身正面有一块小屏幕，测量结束后会显示读数。仪器旁边的地面上贴着一对黄色脚印，标出受检者站立的位置。
body_en: The height and weight scale of the health checkup center stands at the end of the corridor, with a square metal platform as its base and a bar that moves up and down on its upright post. A small screen on the front of the unit shows the reading once a measurement is finished. On the floor beside the device is a pair of yellow footprints, marking where the person being examined stands.

body_zh: 体检当天，受检者先在一楼前台领取体检表，随后到二楼抽血。抽血结束后，护士为受检者测量身高体重和血压，接着进行视力检查。最后一项是三楼的心电图，全部做完后体检表交回前台，报告在一周后发放。
body_en: On the day of the checkup, each person being examined first collects a checkup form at the front desk on the first floor, then goes to the second floor to have blood taken. After the blood draw, a nurse measures height, weight and blood pressure, and a vision test follows. The last item is an electrocardiogram on the third floor, after which the form goes back to the front desk, and the report is issued a week later.

body_zh: 电子处方传到药房后，一名药师核对药品名称和数量，从货架上取出药品放进分装盒。分装盒随即交给第二名药师复核，复核无误后贴上标签，送到发药窗口。叫号屏亮起号码时，患者到窗口取药并签收。
body_en: Once an electronic prescription reaches the pharmacy, a pharmacist checks the drug names and quantities, takes the medicines from the shelves and puts them into a sorting box. The box then goes to a second pharmacist for checking, and once it passes, it is labeled and sent to the dispensing window. When the number lights up on the calling screen, the patient collects the medicine at the window and signs for it.

body_zh: 这个月初，一家工厂的186名员工分三批来到体检中心做年度体检。院方提前加派了6名护士，在抽血区多开了两个窗口。第一批员工早上七点到达，到中午十二点，三批人的检查都已结束，没有人等候超过半小时。
body_en: At the start of this month, 186 employees of a factory came to the health checkup center in three groups for their annual checkup. The hospital had assigned 6 extra nurses in advance and opened two more windows in the blood collection area. The first group arrived at seven in the morning, and by noon the checks for all three groups were over, with nobody waiting longer than half an hour.

body_zh: 有人在门诊候诊区落下了一个布袋，袋里装着一把雨伞和一本相册。保洁员发现后把布袋交到服务台，工作人员随即在大厅里广播了两遍。半小时后，失主回到服务台，说出了袋中的物品，领回了布袋。
body_en: Someone left a cloth bag in the waiting area of the outpatient department, with an umbrella and a photo album inside. A cleaner found it and took it to the service desk, and the staff then announced it twice over the loudspeakers in the hall. Half an hour later, the owner came back to the desk, described what was in the bag, and collected it.

body_zh: 门诊的号源分为普通号和专家号两类，普通号当天在窗口就能挂到，专家号一般提前一周放出。每个专家号都配有一个固定的就诊时段，患者按时段到诊室外候诊。如果当天的号已经挂满，医院会在下午加开一场普通门诊。
body_en: Outpatient appointments come in two types, regular and specialist, and regular ones can be obtained at the window on the same day, while specialist slots are usually released a week in advance. Each specialist slot comes with a fixed consultation time, and patients wait outside the consulting room at their assigned time. When all appointments for the day are taken, the hospital adds an extra regular clinic session in the afternoon.

body_zh: 药房里的药品依据储存条件分区存放，常温药品放在开放式货架上，冷藏药品则收在温度保持在2到8度的冷柜里。冷柜温度每天早晚各记录一次，记录表挂在柜门旁边。外观相近的药品不会放在相邻的格子里，以减少拿错的情况。
body_en: Medicines in the pharmacy are stored in zones according to their storage conditions, with room temperature medicines on open shelves and refrigerated ones in a cabinet kept between 2 and 8 degrees. The cabinet temperature is recorded once in the morning and once in the evening, and the log sheet hangs beside the cabinet door. Medicines that look alike are never placed in neighboring slots, which reduces the chance of picking the wrong one.

body_zh: 本学期初二年级共有6个班，学生总数为258人，其中男生134人。期中考试安排在第10周，数学平均分为81分，比上学期提高了3分。年级组当月还召开了两次家长会，到会家长共计230余人。
body_en: This term the eighth grade has 6 classes with 258 students in all, 134 of them boys. The midterm exam was held in week 10, and the average math score was 81, up 3 points from last term. The grade office also held two parent meetings that month, attended by more than 230 parents in total.

body_zh: 学校图书馆10月份借出图书960册，其中历史类读物最受欢迎，约占三成。午休时段的借还人数最多，平均每天有90人次。月底馆员清点书架，发现有12本书放错了位置，已全部归回原处。
body_en: The school library lent out 960 books in October, with history titles the most popular at about thirty percent of the total. The lunch break saw the most borrowing and returning, with an average of 90 visits a day. At the end of the month the librarians checked the shelves and found 12 books in the wrong places, all of which have been put back.

body_zh: 三楼的化学实验室有八张黑色台面的长桌，每张桌子中间都装着一个水槽。靠窗的墙边是一排通风橱，玻璃门可以上下推拉。讲台后面挂着一张元素周期表，旁边的铁柜里整齐地放着烧杯和试管，柜门上贴着物品清单。
body_en: The chemistry lab on the third floor has eight long tables with black tops, each with a sink fitted in the middle. Along the wall by the windows stands a row of fume hoods whose glass doors slide up and down. A periodic table hangs behind the lectern, and the iron cabinet beside it holds neat rows of beakers and test tubes, with a list of its contents on the door.

body_zh: 学校的操场在教学楼南面，四周是一条红色的塑胶跑道，一圈长400米。跑道围着一块人造草坪足球场，球场两端各有一个白色球门。操场北侧建有一座水泥看台，看台下面是存放体育器材的仓库。
body_en: The sports ground of the school lies south of the teaching building and is ringed by a red rubber track 400 meters to a lap. The track encircles a football pitch of artificial turf, with a white goal at each end. A concrete grandstand stands on the north side of the ground, and beneath it is a storeroom for sports equipment.

body_zh: 开考前十五分钟，监考老师把密封的试卷袋带进考场，当众拆开封条。考生在答题卡上填好考号，静候开考铃声。铃响后考生开始作答，终考铃响起时停笔离座，监考老师按座位顺序收齐答题卡，清点后装袋封存。
body_en: Fifteen minutes before the exam begins, the invigilator brings the sealed bag of papers into the exam room and breaks the seal in front of everyone. Students fill in their exam numbers on the answer sheets and wait quietly for the starting bell. Once it rings they begin working, and when the final bell sounds they put down their pens and leave their seats, while the invigilator collects the answer sheets in seat order, counts them and seals them in a bag.

body_zh: 每天早上7点20分起，学生陆续走进校门，在教室放下书包后开始早读。7点50分广播响起，各班到操场集合做早操。早操结束后学生回到教室，第一节课在8点15分开始，每两节课之间有十分钟的休息。
body_en: From twenty past seven every morning, students stream in through the school gate, leave their bags in their classrooms and begin morning reading. At ten to eight the loudspeakers come on, and each class gathers on the sports ground for morning exercises. After the exercises the students return to their classrooms, the first lesson starts at a quarter past eight, and there is a ten minute break between lessons.

body_zh: 上周五下午，初一三班的学生在生物课上观察洋葱表皮细胞。一个小组的显微镜灯泡突然熄灭，组员们只好轮流使用邻组的显微镜。课后，实验员换上了新灯泡，又逐台检查了其余的显微镜，发现有两台的镜头沾了灰尘。
body_en: Last Friday afternoon, students of Class 3 in the seventh grade were looking at onion skin cells in a biology lesson. The microscope lamp of one group suddenly went out, so its members took turns using the microscope of the neighboring group. After class, the lab technician fitted a new bulb and checked the remaining microscopes one by one, finding dust on the lenses of two of them.

body_zh: 学校运动会的第二天，一场大雨从上午九点下到中午，跑道上积了不少水。裁判组把跳远和铅球比赛推迟到了下午。雨停后，几名体育老师用刮水板清理了跑道，比赛在下午两点重新开始，所有项目赶在傍晚前全部结束。
body_en: On the second day of the school sports meet, heavy rain fell from nine in the morning until noon, leaving a lot of water on the track. The referees moved the long jump and shot put events to the afternoon. After the rain stopped, several physical education teachers cleared the track with squeegees, the competition resumed at two in the afternoon, and every event was finished before evening.

body_zh: 这所中学的课程表以周为单位编排，每天上午四节课，下午三节课，每节课40分钟。语文和数学每周各有五节，体育课每周三节。遇到节假日调休时，教务处会提前三天发布调整后的课表，并张贴在各班的公告栏上。
body_en: The timetable of this middle school is arranged week by week, with four lessons each morning and three each afternoon, each lasting 40 minutes. Chinese and mathematics have five lessons a week each, and physical education has three. When holidays shift the working days, the academic affairs office releases an adjusted timetable three days ahead and posts it on the notice board of every class.

body_zh: 期末总评由平时成绩和考试成绩组成，两者分别占三成和七成。平时成绩来自作业和课堂表现，由任课老师每月登记一次。总评不足60分的学生，可以在下学期开学第一周参加补考，补考及格后成绩记为60分。
body_en: The final grade for a term combines coursework and exam scores, which count for thirty and seventy percent respectively. Coursework scores come from homework and class performance, and the subject teacher records them once a month. Students whose final grade falls below 60 can sit a makeup exam in the first week of the next term, and a pass on the makeup exam is recorded as 60.

body_zh: 上个月，网点新开个人账户174个，其中多数由附近一所大学的新生开立。柜台日均办理业务约140笔，周一的业务量最大。自助取款机月内补充现金9次，最长的一次排队出现在月底的发薪日，持续了大约半小时。
body_en: Last month, the branch opened 174 new personal accounts, most of them opened by new students from a nearby university. The counters handled about 140 transactions a day on average, with Mondays the busiest. The cash machines were refilled 9 times during the month, and the longest queue came on payday at the end of the month, lasting about half an hour.

body_zh: 月初，网点贴出了新的利率表，一年期定期存款年利率下调10个基点，三年期下调15个基点，活期存款利率维持不变。新利率从本月10日起执行，已存入的定期存款不受这次调整影响。此后一周内，网点共接到咨询60余次。
body_en: At the start of the month, the branch put up a new table of interest rates, with the annual rate on one year fixed deposits cut by 10 basis points, the three year rate cut by 15 basis points, and the demand deposit rate unchanged. The new rates take effect on the 10th of this month, and fixed deposits already made are not affected by this change. In the week that followed, the branch received more than 60 inquiries.

body_zh: 网点的营业厅不大，进门右手边是一台取号机，左手边靠墙放着三台自助存取款机。大厅中央有一张填单台，台面上搁着几支用细绳拴住的笔。柜台共有四个窗口，每块玻璃隔板下方都开着一个小槽，用来递送现金和单据。
body_en: The banking hall of the branch is small, with a ticket machine to the right of the entrance and three cash deposit and withdrawal machines against the wall on the left. In the middle of the hall stands a counter for filling in forms, with a few pens tied to it by thin strings. The service counter has four windows, and under each glass partition there is a small slot for passing cash and documents.

body_zh: 存折是一本巴掌大小的小册子，带着深绿色的硬纸封面。第一页印着账号和开户日期，后面每页都分成若干横栏。每次存取款后，柜员把存折放进打印机，交易日期和余额便印在新的一行上。
body_en: A passbook is a palm sized booklet with a cover of dark green card. The first page carries the account number and the date the account was opened, and every page after that is divided into rows. After each deposit or withdrawal, the teller puts the passbook into a printer, and the date and balance of the transaction are printed on a new line.

body_zh: 开立储蓄账户的第一步是在取号机上取号，然后在等候区等待叫号。叫到号后，客户把身份证件交给柜员，由柜员核验并录入信息。接下来客户在确认单上签名并设置密码，最后领到一张银行卡，整个过程约二十分钟。
body_en: The first step in opening a savings account is to take a number from the ticket machine and wait in the waiting area to be called. When the number is called, the customer hands an identity document to the teller, who verifies it and enters the details. Next the customer signs a confirmation form and sets a password, and finally receives a bank card, with the whole process taking about twenty minutes.

body_zh: 营业结束后，柜员把各自的现金按面额分类清点，与当天的账目逐笔核对。核对一致后，现金装入带编号的款箱，由两名员工共同封箱。晚上七点左右押运车到达网点，双方签字交接后，款箱被运往金库。
body_en: After the branch closes for the day, each teller sorts and counts their cash by denomination and checks it item by item against the accounts of the day. Once the figures agree, the cash goes into numbered boxes, which two staff members seal together. At about seven in the evening a cash transport van reaches the branch, and after both sides sign the handover, the boxes are taken to the vault.

body_zh: 暑假里的一个上午，一群小学生在老师的带领下参观了网点。大堂经理带着孩子们看了点钞机，又教他们辨认纸币上的水印。最后，孩子们在柜台前排好队，每人用零花钱存了一笔小额存款，领到了第一本存折。
body_en: One morning during the summer holiday, a group of primary school pupils visited the branch with their teacher. The lobby manager showed the children a banknote counting machine and taught them to recognize the watermarks on banknotes. At the end, the children lined up at the counter, each made a small deposit with pocket money, and received their first passbook.

body_zh: 周末上午，一位老人提着一袋硬币来到网点，打算把它们换成纸币。柜员把硬币倒进清分机，机器把不同面值的硬币分开并逐一计数。结果共有860枚硬币，合计347元，老人把换好的纸币装进衣袋，满意地离开了。
body_en: On a weekend morning, an elderly man came to the branch carrying a bag of coins, intending to change them into notes. The teller poured the coins into a sorting machine, which separated coins of different values and counted them one by one. There turned out to be 860 coins worth 347 yuan in total, and the man put the notes into his pocket and left looking pleased.

body_zh: 定期存款若在到期前支取，利息按支取当天的活期利率计算。每张存单只能部分提前支取一次，剩余部分仍按原利率计息，到期日也保持不变。存款到期时如果没有办理任何手续，银行通常会自动按原期限转存。
body_en: When a fixed deposit is withdrawn before maturity, the interest is calculated at the demand deposit rate on the day of withdrawal. Each certificate allows only one partial early withdrawal, the remaining balance still earns interest at the original rate, and the maturity date stays the same. If no action is taken when the deposit matures, the bank usually rolls it over automatically for the original term.

body_zh: 同一家银行内部的转账一般即时到账，跨行转账在工作日通常几分钟内就能完成。金额较大的跨行汇款走另一条清算通道，这条通道只在工作日开放，晚上和周末暂停运行。节假日发起的这类汇款，会顺延到下一个工作日处理。
body_en: Transfers within the same bank usually arrive instantly, and transfers between banks on working days are normally completed within a few minutes. Large transfers between banks go through a separate clearing channel, which opens only on working days and pauses in the evenings and at weekends. Such transfers started during holidays are processed on the next working day.

body_zh: 18路公交车全程共设23个站点，单程运行约50分钟。工作日早高峰的发车间隔为6分钟，平峰时段延长到12分钟。从上个月的统计看，这条线路日均载客近万人次，以周五傍晚的乘客最多。
body_en: Bus Route 18 has 23 stops along its full length, and a single trip takes about 50 minutes. During the weekday morning peak a bus leaves every 6 minutes, and in off peak hours the interval grows to 12 minutes. Figures for last month show that the route carried nearly ten thousand passenger trips a day, with Friday evenings the busiest.

body_zh: 长假第一天，这座小城的火车站发送旅客8200人次，创下今年单日最高纪录。车站临时增开了3个售票窗口，并安排40名志愿者在广场和候车室引导旅客。当天加开的两趟临时列车，上座率都超过了九成。
body_en: On the first day of the long holiday, the railway station of the small city sent off 8200 passengers, the highest figure for a single day this year. The station opened 3 extra ticket windows and placed 40 volunteers in the square and the waiting rooms to guide travelers. The two extra trains added that day were both more than ninety percent full.

body_zh: 这个公交站台建在一排梧桐树下，顶棚是半透明的弧形板，下面放着一条不锈钢长椅。站牌立在站台东端，上面标着四条线路的首末班时间。站台边缘刷着一道黄色的线，地面上还嵌着一排供盲人行走的凸起砖。
body_en: The bus stop stands under a row of plane trees, with a curved translucent canopy and a stainless steel bench beneath it. The route sign is fixed at the east end of the platform and shows the first and last bus times of four routes. A yellow line is painted along the edge of the platform, and a row of raised tiles for blind pedestrians is set into the ground.

body_zh: 高铁二等座车厢里每排有五个座位，过道左边三个，右边两个。座椅蒙着蓝灰色的布面，靠背可以向后调节，前排椅背上装着折叠小桌板。车厢两端的门楣上各有一块显示屏，轮流显示车次和下一站的站名。
body_en: In a second class carriage of the high speed train, each row has five seats, three to the left of the aisle and two to the right. The seats are covered in blue gray fabric, the backrests recline, and a folding tray table is fitted to the back of each seat in front. Above the doors at both ends of the carriage there is a screen that shows the train number and the name of the next station in turn.

body_zh: 乘客到达火车站后，先在进站口刷身份证并通过安检，再到大厅的屏幕上查找候车区。列车到站前一刻钟开始检票，乘客经闸机进入站台，按票面上的车厢号找到上车位置。列车停稳后，乘客依次上车，对号入座。
body_en: After arriving at the railway station, passengers first scan their identity cards at the entrance and pass through the security check, then look up their waiting area on the screens in the hall. Ticket checking begins a quarter of an hour before the train arrives, and passengers go through the gates onto the platform and find the boarding point for the carriage number on their tickets. Once the train has stopped, passengers board in turn and take the seats shown on their tickets.

body_zh: 这段道路的夜间翻修从晚上十点开始，施工队先在两端摆放锥桶，把车流引到对向车道。铣刨机随后削去旧的沥青面层，清扫车紧跟着清理碎屑。摊铺机铺好新沥青后，压路机来回碾压几遍，到第二天清晨六点，道路重新开放通行。
body_en: Night resurfacing on this stretch of road starts at ten in the evening, when the crew first sets out traffic cones at both ends and diverts vehicles into the opposite lane. A milling machine then strips away the old asphalt surface, with a sweeper close behind to clear the debris. After the paver has laid the new asphalt, a road roller passes back and forth several times, and by six the next morning the road is open to traffic again.

body_zh: 周二清晨，城郊的高速公路上起了浓雾，能见度降到不足一百米。收费站暂时关闭了入口，已在路上的车辆在交警引导下低速行驶。上午十点雾气散去，入口恢复放行，收费站前积压的车辆直到十点半才全部通过。
body_en: Early on Tuesday morning, thick fog settled over the expressway on the edge of the city, and visibility dropped below one hundred meters. The toll station closed its entrance for a while, and vehicles already on the road drove slowly under the guidance of traffic police. The fog cleared at ten in the morning, the entrance opened again, and it was not until half past ten that all the vehicles held up at the toll station had passed through.

body_zh: 本周一，连接火车站和城东新区的32路公交线路正式开通，首班车于早上六点从火车站始发。开通当天，线路上的12辆电动公交车共载客约1500人次。在终点站下车的乘客，大多步行前往附近的工业园区上班。
body_en: This Monday, the Route 32 bus line linking the railway station with the new eastern district officially opened, with the first bus setting off from the station at six in the morning. On the opening day, the 12 electric buses on the route carried about 1500 passenger trips. Most passengers getting off at the terminus walked on to work in the nearby industrial park.

body_zh: 城市路口的红绿灯时长并不固定，不少路口会根据车流量调整绿灯的长短。早高峰期间，进城方向的绿灯时间延长，出城方向则随之缩短。到了深夜，车流变得稀少，部分路口的信号灯改为黄灯持续闪烁。
body_en: Traffic lights at city intersections do not run on fixed timings, and many intersections adjust the length of the green phase to the volume of traffic. During the morning peak, the green phase for traffic heading into the city is longer, while the one for traffic heading out is shortened. Late at night, when traffic thins out, the lights at some intersections switch to a steady flashing amber.

body_zh: 这座城市的地铁票价随乘车里程分段递增，6公里以内3元，6到12公里4元，之后每增加10公里加收1元。乘客进站和出站时各刷一次卡，闸机根据两次刷卡的站点计算票价。同一站进出的，按最低票价扣费。
body_en: Metro fares in this city rise in bands with the distance travelled, at 3 yuan within 6 kilometers and 4 yuan for 6 to 12 kilometers, plus 1 yuan for every further 10 kilometers. Passengers tap their cards once on entering and once on leaving, and the gates work out the fare from the two stations. A trip that enters and leaves at the same station is charged the lowest fare.

body_zh: 村东的那片地今年种了12亩玉米，四月下旬播种，九月中旬开始收割。全部收完后，共打下玉米约1万斤，平均亩产800多斤，是近五年来最好的收成。晒干的玉米大多卖给了镇上的收购点。
body_en: This year the field east of the village was planted with 12 mu of maize, sown in late April and harvested from mid September. When the harvest was in, it had yielded about ten thousand jin of maize, more than 800 jin per mu on average, the best crop in five years. Most of the dried maize was sold to the buying station in the town.

body_zh: 育秧大棚里共摆放了2400个秧盘，播种后第5天出苗率达到九成以上。棚内白天温度控制在25度左右，夜间不低于15度。秧苗长到第20天时，平均高度约为12厘米，已经可以移栽到大田里。
body_en: The seedling greenhouse held 2400 seedling trays, and by the fifth day after sowing more than ninety percent of the seeds had come up. Inside, the daytime temperature was kept at around 25 degrees and did not fall below 15 at night. By the twentieth day the seedlings stood about 12 centimeters tall on average, ready to be transplanted to the fields.

body_zh: 山脚下的这片稻田被田埂分成大小不一的十几块，田边有一条水渠，渠水从上游的水库引来，常年不断。田埂上长着青草和几丛野菊，几只白鹭常在水田里觅食。靠近村口的地方搭着一间堆放农具的小棚子。
body_en: The rice paddies at the foot of the hill are divided by earth ridges into a dozen or so plots of different sizes, and a canal runs along the edge of the fields, fed all year round by water from a reservoir upstream. Grass and a few clumps of wild chrysanthemums grow on the ridges, and several egrets often feed in the flooded fields. Near the entrance to the village stands a small shed piled with farm tools.

body_zh: 村头的粮仓用红砖砌成，外墙刷了一层白灰，屋顶铺着灰瓦。仓门是厚实的木门，离地面有半米高，门前砌着三级台阶。仓内地面垫着木板，四周墙上开着几扇小窗，用来通风防潮。
body_en: The granary at the edge of the village is built of red brick, with its outer walls coated in white lime and its roof covered with gray tiles. The door is made of thick wood and sits half a meter above the ground, with three steps built in front of it. Inside, the floor is lined with wooden boards, and several small windows in the walls let air through and keep out the damp.

body_zh: 春播前，农户先用旋耕机把地翻松，再耙平地表。接着按照每行60厘米的间距开沟，把种子均匀撒进沟里，覆上一层薄土。播完后用镇压器压实土壤，最后沿着垄沟浇一遍水。
body_en: Before spring sowing, the farmers first loosen the soil with a rotary tiller and then rake the surface level. Next they open furrows 60 centimeters apart, scatter the seeds evenly into them and cover them with a thin layer of soil. After sowing, the soil is pressed firm with a roller, and finally water is run once along the furrows.

body_zh: 麦子成熟后，联合收割机从地头开进麦田，一边收割一边脱粒。收割机的粮箱装满后，麦粒被卸到停在地边的拖拉机上。拖拉机把麦粒运到晒场，摊开晾晒两三天，等水分降下来后，再装袋送往粮站。
body_en: When the wheat is ripe, a combine harvester drives into the field from the headland, cutting and threshing as it goes. Once the grain tank of the harvester is full, the grain is unloaded onto a tractor waiting at the edge of the field. The tractor carries the grain to the drying yard, where it is spread out to dry for two or three days, and once its moisture has dropped it is bagged and sent to the grain depot.

body_zh: 秋收那天上午，一台拖拉机在田边的低洼处陷进了泥里，后轮越转越深。司机找来两块木板垫在轮下，又叫来邻居开着另一台拖拉机帮忙牵引。两台车用钢丝绳连在一起，不到十分钟就把陷住的那台拉了出来。
body_en: On a morning during the autumn harvest, a tractor sank into the mud in a low patch at the edge of a field, its rear wheels digging deeper with every turn. The driver found two planks to put under the wheels and called over a neighbor, who brought another tractor to help tow it. The two vehicles were linked with a steel cable, and in less than ten minutes the stuck tractor had been pulled free.

body_zh: 七月中旬，镇农技站带来一架植保无人机，在合作社的稻田里试飞播撒肥料。无人机按照设定的航线来回飞行，每趟能覆盖大约20亩地。一上午下来，200亩稻田全部撒完，围观的农户在田埂上看了很久。
body_en: In mid July, the agricultural technology station of the town brought a crop spraying drone to test spreading fertilizer over the rice fields of the cooperative. The drone flew back and forth along a preset route, covering about 20 mu on each run. By the end of the morning all 200 mu had been covered, and the farmers watching from the ridges stayed for a long time.

body_zh: 这一带的农田实行小麦和玉米轮作，一年收获两季。小麦在十月播种，第二年六月收割，麦收一结束就在麦茬地里播下玉米。玉米九月成熟，收获后土地稍作休整，又开始新一轮的小麦播种。
body_en: Farmland in this area follows a rotation of wheat and maize, giving two harvests a year. Wheat is sown in October and harvested in June of the following year, and maize is sown straight into the wheat stubble as soon as the wheat harvest ends. The maize ripens in September, and after it is harvested the land rests briefly before a new round of wheat sowing begins.

body_zh: 水稻分蘖到一定数量后，稻田里的水会被排干，让田面晒上五到七天，这一做法叫作晒田。晒田能让土壤透气，促使根系向深处生长，也能减少后期长出的无效分蘖。晒田结束后，田里重新灌上浅水。
body_en: Once rice plants have produced enough tillers, the water in the paddy is drained and the field surface is left to dry for five to seven days, a practice known as field drying. Drying lets air into the soil, encourages the roots to grow deeper, and reduces the unproductive tillers that would otherwise form later. When the drying is over, the field is flooded again with shallow water.
